bean.description: Stripe PaymentIntent of a cart, as the storefront needs it to confirm the payment.
Public Stripe configuration of a base site.
Result of a Stripe webhook call.
Stripe payment of a cart or an order.

property.name: paymentStatus
property.description: ACCEPTED, PENDING or FAILED. Empty while the payment has no result.

property.name: instructionsUrl
property.description: Stripe page with the payment instructions of a voucher or a bank transfer.

property.name: paymentReference
property.description: Reference that the customer gives with a voucher or bank transfer payment.

property.name: instructionsExpireAt
property.description: End of the period in which the customer can pay the voucher.

property.name: amountRemaining
property.description: Amount still to pay by bank transfer, formatted in the currency of the order. Only while the payment is PENDING.
